metadata.case_name: YUEN CHUNG SHUN v. ON ASCENT LIMITED

injuries.description: soft tissue injury in or about the lower back
source: the plaintiff sustained an injury to his lower back.

the joint experts agreed that the plaintiff's injury was of soft tissue origin, there being no suggestion of more serious damage such as a bony fracture. Nor was there a suggestion of neurological deficit.

an injury of the kind diagnosed by the two doctors - a soft tissue injury in or about the lower back - presents particular difficulties, considerable reliance having to be placed on the subjective views of the injured person.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

manifestations.description: sharp pain in his lower back
tenderness over the area of the lower back
persistent lower back pain and tightness
used a walking stick (for a time, until early 2011; possibly only on rainy days)
weakness in both legs when walking up and down stairs
major areas of dysfunction were related to his strength in lifting and "bilateral carrying" and "positional tolerance" when standing

treatments_future: further limited psychiatric treatment on an out-patient basis
exercise to strengthen the back / rehabilitation exercises

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Yuet Keung v Harmony (International) Knitting Factory Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff slipped and fell suffering a soft tissue injury to his back. It was likely that the injury was an important causal factor of a disc extrusion at L5/S1 level, resulting in persistent low back pain.

comparable_cases.case_name: Mohammad Waheed Khan v Rising Sun Transportation Company Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: soft tissue sprain injury to his lower back; some residual back pain when walking, dressing, and undertaking daily activities.

comparable_cases.case_name: Fong Yuet Ha v Success Employment Services Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: soft tissue injuries to the left forearm, right heel, right buttock and lower back with some psychiatric trauma (insomnia, irritability and headaches) and adjustment disorder with depressive mood.
